theorems.name: Submission.ted_lpm_am_cutoff_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (S T t : ℝ), 0 < t → 1 ≤ T → T * t ≤ S → IntegrableOn g (closedBall y S) μ → (∀ k, Continuous (φ k)) → (∀ k s, 0 ≤ φ k s ∧ φ k s ≤ 1) → (∀ k s, s ≤ 1 → φ k s = 1) → (∀ k s, T ≤ s → φ k s = 0) → (∀ s, 1 < s → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, φ k s = 0) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, φ k (‖x - y‖ / t) * g x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in closedBall y t, g x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
